problem.currentState: Supplier invoices arrive by email as PDFs and are manually keyed into the finance system by the Accounts Payable team. Each invoice is then emailed to a budget owner for approval, and approvals are chased manually when they stall. Invoices regularly miss payment terms, and there is no single view of where an invoice is in the process.
problem.strategicAlignment: Reducing manual processing in back-office functions is a key pillar of the company's operational efficiency strategy. Faster, more reliable supplier payments also support our goal of becoming a preferred partner for key suppliers.

solution.futureState: Invoices sent to a shared inbox are automatically read, and key fields (supplier, amount, PO number, due date) are extracted and matched against purchase orders. Matched invoices are routed to the right budget owner for one-click approval, with automatic reminders and escalation. The MVP covers PO-backed invoices from the top 50 suppliers.
keyFeatures: Automatic capture of invoices from the shared AP inbox
Extraction of supplier, amount, PO number and due date from PDF invoices
Automatic matching of invoices to purchase orders
Approval routing to budget owners with one-click approve / reject
Automated reminders and escalation for overdue approvals
Dashboard showing the status of every invoice in progress

goals: Reduce average invoice processing time from 9 days to 3 days
Cut AP team effort per invoice by at least 75%
Increase invoices paid within terms from 72% to 95%
Give finance a real-time view of all invoices in progress
nonGoals: Non-PO invoices - these need a separate coding process and will follow in phase 2
Paper invoices - fewer than 3% of volume, to be handled manually
Changes to the payment run itself - this stays in the existing finance system

milestones.description: Current process mapped, supplier invoice samples collected, requirements signed off
Invoice capture, field extraction and PO matching working in test
Routing, approvals, reminders and dashboard complete
Live with 10 suppliers and the AP team

risks.risk: Extraction accuracy is too low for some invoice layouts
risks.mitigation: Test against samples from all top 50 suppliers early; route low-confidence invoices to manual review

risks.risk: Budget owners don't adopt the new approval flow
risks.mitigation: Keep approvals to one click from email; brief budget owners before pilot

risks.risk: Finance system API access is delayed
risks.mitigation: Raise access request in discovery; fall back to a CSV export for the pilot

dependencies.requirement: Read access to purchase orders and write access to approved invoices
Service account access to read incoming invoices
Up-to-date mapping of cost centres to approvers

assumptions: At least 85% of invoices from the top 50 suppliers include a valid PO number
Budget owners will approve invoices from email or mobile without logging into the finance system
Current invoice volumes (around 9,000 per year) stay roughly the same through rollout
